description: v2 UI redesign on Astryx (React + StyleX), a parallel flag-gated shell in the same Vite app; v1 stays default and untouched until parity. THE SIDEBAR+TOOLBAR SHELL MILESTONE IS COMPLETE (see completedMilestone) — this queue now tracks remaining v2 polish only; the functional wire-up is a separate Phase 2 PRD (TBD). READ docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md BEFORE any story. Backend/gateway is UNCHANGED; v2 is presentation only.

designFile.howToUse: If the Paper MCP is connected (Paper desktop running with the file open), pull EXACT values with get_computed_styles / get_jsx / get_fill_image on the node id for your slot and get_screenshot to compare — never read sizes/colors off a screenshot. If the Paper MCP is NOT available on this machine, work from the IA + measurements in docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md and this spec, and ping the PM (Claude on the design machine) for exact token values.

conventions.astryxOnly: v2 components use @astryxdesign/core only. Do NOT import shadcn/Radix or Tailwind classes into ui/src/v2/.
conventions.tokensOnly: Consume ui/src/v2/tokens.css CSS variables (created in US-001). No hardcoded hex, no Tailwind utility classes.
conventions.astryxDocs: Every story's `notes` lists the Astryx components it needs, each with a doc-page link (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/<PascalCaseName>) AND the authoritative CLI command (`npx astryx component <Name> --props --json`). The doc URLs are best-effort — Astryx is pre-1.0 (0.1.9) and some exact names/slugs are unconfirmed. If a doc URL 404s or the CLI reports no match, the CLI is the source of truth: browse https://astryx.atmeta.com/components or run `npx astryx search <term>` to find the real component, then use `npx astryx component <RealName> --props --json`. Also: `npx astryx docs tokens --json` for the token surface.
conventions.fileOwnership: US-001 creates every slot's stub file + wires them into Sidebar.tsx / Toolbar.tsx / App.v2.tsx. Each later story implements ONLY its own leaf component file(s) — do NOT edit App.v2.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, Toolbar.tsx, or another story's file (avoids parallel-worktree merge conflicts). Layout/composition edits belong to US-007.
conventions.v1Untouched: No edits to v1 components, ui/src/index.css (Astryx CSS is dynamic-imported in the v2 entry only), or src/ (gateway). v1 must render pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF.
conventions.gatewayRule: Never run a human's :3747 gateway or :5173 Vite from an agent session (dies on teardown). Browser-QA uses a throwaway port stack.

userStories.title: Shell a11y + cleanup — real tab semantics for surface tabs, sweep interactive roles
userStories.description: As a keyboard / assistive-tech user, I want the toolbar surface tabs and the other shell controls to be real, focusable, correctly-roled elements, so the v2 shell is fully navigable without a mouse.
acceptanceCriteria: Surface tabs get real tab semantics: a role=tablist container with role=tab items (prefer Astryx's own TabList/Tab if it ships them — check `npx astryx component TabList` / `Tabs` --props --json), keyboard-focusable with arrow-key movement between tabs; today they render as bare <div>s (confirmed via the a11y tree) and are not reachable by keyboard
Each closeable tab's ✕ is a real focusable button with an aria-label (e.g. 'Close Browser tab')

Sweep the rest of the v2 shell for the same issue — search field, project-group toggles, thread rows, Actions/Open/Commit & Push, Settings — each must be a real button/link/input with an accessible name; no click/hover behavior on non-interactive <div>s
Remove the now-unused ui/src/v2/components/NewChatButton.tsx (the RJ-0 footer is Settings-only; the file is dead since commit c19e609)
Astryx components + ui/src/v2/tokens.css only — no shadcn/Tailwind/hardcoded hex; v1 stays untouched (flag OFF renders v1 pixel-unchanged)
cd ui && npm run build passes; the existing v2 Vitest suite still passes

Verify with automate-browser on a throwaway port (VITE_CONAN_V2=1, dark): Tab through the shell and confirm focus reaches the surface tabs and arrow keys move between them; re-screenshot to confirm no visual regression vs RJ-0
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-07-30 and promoted in checkpoint/v2-t101. SurfaceTabs real tablist + arrow-key movement + close-button labels (Claude), sidebar a11y sweep (Codex), toolbar a11y sweep (Grok). Post-merge fixes: title injection across preview stacks, ProjectTree section-header action icon alignment. 46 tests passing; typecheck/build clean. Suggested skills: automate-browser, audit-ui.

completedMilestone: Shell milestone DONE in the first multi-agent run (commits 4331e92..ea05306). Shipped in ui/src/v2/: the Astryx pipeline + flag + CSS isolation + tokens/fonts (T0), and the full sidebar+toolbar shell — SidebarHeader, SearchInput, ProjectTree, ThreadRow, SettingsFooter, Breadcrumb, SurfaceTabs, SecondaryBar — assembled in App.v2.tsx / Sidebar.tsx / Toolbar.tsx, with a Vitest suite. Verified live against the Paper RJ-0 artboard: renders clean at 1512x982 dark, zero console errors, faithful to the design. The former build stories US-001..US-007 are complete and pruned from the queue (their acceptance criteria live in git history). Remaining polish is below; functional wiring is Phase 2.
